title: UI风格#41 - Jungle Safari (丛林探险)
description: 创建第41种UI风格：丛林探险风格 - 原始森林、野生动物、叶脉纹理。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAO.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari style When color palette Then features jungle greens, earth browns, sunset oranges, animal prints
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #228B22 (森林绿), #8B4513 (土地棕), #FF8C00 (日落橙), #F5DEB3 (沙色), #2F4F2F (暗叶)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari style When typography Then uses adventurous fonts: Adventurer, Long Curl, or Patrick Hand
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Long Curl (标题), Patrick Hand (正文)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari style When layout Then leaf textures, vine borders, animal silhouette headers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: leaf overlay (CSS repeating SVG), vine borders (gradient lines), earth gradient background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari style When UI elements Then organic buttons, vine animations, leaf overlays
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: vine-border sidebar, leaf-overlay texture, compass icon, organic border-radius on cards

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari UI When functional Then includes explorer chat, wild agents, trail stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: chat with compass header, 4 agent cards (Lion/Elephant/Giraffe/Leopard) with trail stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Jungle Safari UI When copy Then uses expedition language: 'Explorer', 'Trail', 'Wild', 'Roam'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'EXPLORE. TRAIL. WILD.', button 'TRACK', status 'Roaming'/'Tracking', nav 'Base Camp'/'Summit'
